summary:
Radar snapshot, 2026-11-25 (GLP-1 focus). Three things are new in this snapshot.

1. **Foundayo sleep apnea results (ATTAIN-OSA).** In adults with obesity or overweight who weren't using a CPAP or other breathing machine, orforglipron (Foundayo) cut breathing interruptions during sleep by 43.8% at 52 weeks. Among people already using one, the cut was 27.5%. The trial was randomized and placebo-controlled. HCPLive picked it up on 11-24 and Lilly plans to file with the FDA by the end of 2026. This is a randomized result for a drug name people search, so it qualifies for a fast-turn long video. It also lets us refresh the Foundayo series.
2. **RSNA 2026 breast density study.** This is the biggest mainstream wave today: TODAY, MedPage, Medical News Today, Everyday Health, Yahoo and AuntMinnie all ran it. In 107 women who took a GLP-1 for at least a year, 62.5% moved up at least one breast-density category and 22.4% were called back after screening, against roughly 8–10% usually. There are almost no creator videos on it. It's emerging, but it needs careful framing: the study is small and retrospective, and it does not show a cancer link.
3. **Thanksgiving is tomorrow.** Holiday-table Shorts have one last 24–48 h window.

The search-demand formats (pen how-to, what-to-expect timelines, label changes, Mounjaro vs Ozempic, tirzepatide hair loss and nausea) stay in as standing high-value candidates, each with a fresh hook from this week's signals: the Medscape gallbladder piece, a glaucoma meta-analysis, a GP's warning about weight regain, ABC Australia's falls and fractures story, and the prebiotic-soda pilot RCT.

Lower priority and marked caution: STEP Young (semaglutide in children aged 6–11, NEJM 16 Nov), the male testosterone and sperm-count story, and retatrutide sleep apnea (pipeline drug, gray-market risk).

Rejected: the compounded-pharmacy recall and price-index stories, Medicare negotiation and cost stories, illegal online retatrutide sales, the chocolate GLP-1 product, Ozempic lawsuit pieces, and stock stories.

candidates.topic: Foundayo (orforglipron) and sleep apnea: what the randomized ATTAIN-OSA trials showed (43.8% fewer breathing interruptions at 52 weeks without a breathing machine; 27.5% for people already using one)
candidates.angle: Fast-turn long video (Exp I), drug first: 'Foundayo (Orforglipron) Sleep Apnea: How Much Did It Help?' Sentence 1 gives the 43.8% figure and the population: adults with obesity or overweight and moderate-to-severe sleep apnea. Present it as a trial result, not an approved use: Lilly plans to file with the FDA by the end of 2026. Link it to the Foundayo What to Expect video and the old Foundayo video (LWyUfli67CI). Check our 11-21 Sleep Apnea video first so this doesn't repeat it: different drug, different trial. Close with a 'talk to your doctor' line.
candidates.predicted_peak: 5–14 days (peaks again at the FDA filing)
candidates.why_now: HCPLive covered it on 11-24, after the AHA presentation. 'Foundayo' and 'orforglipron' search already brings the old Foundayo video 45–60 min a day. This is a randomized result for a drug people search by name, which is the EloraTZP pattern. Mainstream and creator coverage is still thin.

evidence.signal: Orforglipron reduces sleep apnea severity in ATTAIN-OSA
Oral GLP-1 linked to fewer breathing interruptions; 26–28% placebo-adjusted cut in AHI
Oral GLP-1 reduced sleep apnea severity and improved cardiometabolic risk factors
Lilly heads to the FDA to add sleep apnea to the Foundayo label

candidates.topic: Foundayo (orforglipron) pill: what to expect, from the label (approved in the US, Canada and Australia; now with the sleep apnea trial result as a fresh hook)
candidates.angle: Queue item 1. The 11-24 render is already made: don't script it again. Ship it with the Medication Guide fixes. Pair it with a Foundayo felt-moment Short (for example, 'Foundayo pill: nausea in week one, is this normal?') whose post notes point to the long video. ATTAIN-OSA can go in the description or pinned comment as a 'what's next' note, never as an approved use.
candidates.predicted_peak: ongoing; 2–4 weeks as pharmacy launches roll out
candidates.why_now: This topic has been in the radar 4 times with momentum around 88–90. The old Foundayo video is our second-fastest-growing earner, and Foundayo Shorts reached 897 and 841 views against a median of about 47. Lilly's Medicare Part D access page (11-23) and the UK 'regulation has tightened' coverage keep the name in the news.

evidence.signal: What Medicare Part D patients need to know about Foundayo and Zepbound
Wegovy, Foundayo, Mounjaro update as 'regulation has tightened'
Foundayo ATTAIN-OSA results; safety consistent with earlier trials, mostly GI side effects

candidates.topic: Called back after a mammogram while on a GLP-1? The RSNA 2026 study on breast density (62.5% of 107 women moved up a density category; 22.4% recall rate vs a typical ~8–10%)
candidates.angle: A calm 'Is this normal?' practical moment: 'On Ozempic or Mounjaro and called back after your mammogram? A new study may explain why.' Give the relief fact in the same sentence: as breast fat shrinks, the denser tissue makes up more of what's left, so it looks denser on the scan. The study did not link GLP-1s to breast cancer. One practical step: tell your imaging team you're on a GLP-1 and that you've lost weight. Make clear it's a small, retrospective conference study. Never imply cancer risk, and never suggest skipping screening.
candidates.why_now: Within 24 h it was covered by TODAY (twice), MedPage Today, Medical News Today, Everyday Health, Yahoo Health, AuntMinnie, Diagnostic Imaging and healthcare-in-europe. Searches found no dedicated creator video yet. It's a felt, practical moment for women 40–65, a core part of our audience.

evidence.signal: GLP-1 use tied to higher breast density
107 women; 62.5% moved up a density category; 22.4% recall rate
GLP-1s tied to higher breast density and mammogram recalls
Density may only appear higher because fat is lost; no cancer link has been shown

candidates.topic: Thanksgiving on tirzepatide: full after a few bites, the morning-after heaviness, stuffing and heartburn (last window)
candidates.angle: The 20:00 holiday-table Short slot runs through 11-27. Use felt moments only: 'Mounjaro and still full the morning after Thanksgiving? Here's why.' Give the relief fact in the same sentence (slower stomach emptying) and keep red flags short and late. Post notes point to the Thanksgiving long video. Don't make another Thanksgiving long video.
candidates.why_now: Thanksgiving is tomorrow. TODAY, NewsNation, Yahoo, CVS Health and FEE all ran GLP-1 Thanksgiving pieces. Our holiday felt-symptom Shorts got 491, 320 and 263 views.

evidence.signal: Doctors share the best and worst Thanksgiving foods on a GLP-1
GLP-1 and diabetes holiday tips: 7 questions answered
On Ozempic or Wegovy? How to navigate Thanksgiving dinner

candidates.topic: Mounjaro vs Ozempic: which lowered A1C more? (SURPASS-2: adults with type 2 diabetes on metformin, 40 weeks, each tirzepatide arm vs semaglutide 1 mg)
candidates.angle: An approved-drug head-to-head against tirzepatide. The video was made on 11-23 and shipped without the brand names in the title, so retitle it 'Mounjaro vs Ozempic: Which Lowered A1C More?' Give the result first and the population in the same sentence. Every arm is compared as reported, with no dose advice. Link it to Zepbound vs Wegovy. Don't make a new video; fix and promote the existing one.
keywords: mounjaro or ozempic which is better
candidates.why_now: Head-to-heads beat channel norms by 10–195x in this niche. A tirzepatide vs semaglutide cohort study on heart and kidney outcomes (Clin Med Insights Cardiol) and a spinal-infection comparison are circulating. Brand-name search is the engine that works for us.

evidence.signal: Tirzepatide vs semaglutide once weekly in type 2 diabetes
Tirzepatide vs semaglutide heart and kidney outcomes, propensity-matched cohort (supporting only)

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide hair loss: why it's more common in women (label 5.4% vs 0.9%; women 7.1% vs 1.3%) and whether it grows back
candidates.angle: Felt-symptom search format. Retitle the existing long video 'Tirzepatide (Mounjaro) Hair Loss: Why More in Women?' and make a calm 'Is this normal?' Short ('Zepbound and more hair in the brush?') with the relief fact in the same sentence. Post notes point to Hair Loss.
keywords: does hair grow back after mounjaro
candidates.why_now: It has been in 7 snapshots in a row. A run of SEO pages on 'Zepbound hair loss' and 'thinning hair' (23–24 Nov) signals live search demand. Our Hair Short is the best-performing body Short (1,034).

evidence.signal: Hair loss 5.4% vs 0.9% placebo, more often in women
US survey of skin and hair effects of GLP-1-related weight loss

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide nausea: why it happens and when it usually eases, plus the new randomized pilot on a prebiotic soda for GI symptoms
candidates.angle: Felt-symptom search format: 'Mounjaro nausea: when does it ease?' Answer in sentence 1: per the label, mostly during dose escalation, and it decreases over time. Use the prebiotic-soda pilot RCT only as a supporting fact (small pilot, not a recommendation). Make it a chapter or Short, not a new single-symptom long video.
candidates.why_now: Steady top felt-symptom search. The Diabetes Obes Metab pilot RCT (19 Nov) adds a fresh hook, and the 'digestive changes on tirzepatide' SEO pages show demand.

evidence.signal: Prebiotic functional soda vs control for GI symptoms on GLP-1 therapy: randomized pilot
GI reactions mostly during dose escalation, decreasing over time

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide (Mounjaro, Zepbound) after 6 months: what to expect, from the label and SURMOUNT-1 through 72 weeks (series part 3)
candidates.angle: What-to-expect timeline, queue item 4. Answer in sentence 1. Use SURMOUNT-1's curve to explain the slowing and leveling-off as normal. Must not repeat Plateau or How Long. Link it to Months 2–6 (Aqv2dOU-SmM) and Stopping.
candidates.predicted_peak: evergreen; spikes again in the New Year
candidates.why_now: There's a flood of 'what to expect after 2/3 months' and 'weight loss timeline' SEO pages (23 Nov), and the KFDM nurse-practitioner piece covers the same ground. The New Year resolution season starts in 5 weeks.

evidence.signal: 72-week weight curve for tirzepatide vs placebo
Nurse practitioner on what to expect from weight-loss meds

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide serious risks: how rare are they? Gallbladder problems (Medscape 24 Nov), pancreatitis, and the NAION eye warning from the label
candidates.angle: Label-change and safety format, queue item 3 (re-time the held render). Use the Medscape gallbladder piece as a fresh hook for a Short: 'Mounjaro and pain under your right ribs: is it your gallbladder?' Give the symptoms to know and say when to call a clinician. Keep the NAION figures as published by the FDA (6.4 vs 3.8 per 100,000 per year). Pancreatitis figures go only with their paired numbers. The glaucoma meta-analysis and pancreatitis-severity cohort are supporting context only.
candidates.why_now: Medscape covered gallbladder management during rapid GLP-1 weight loss on 24 Nov. Expert commentary on the NAION label (Devdiscourse, ANI, KevinMD, 23 Nov) and drug-lawsuit sites keep driving safety searches. A glaucoma meta-analysis came out 18 Nov.

evidence.signal: Managing gallbladder risks during rapid GLP-1 weight loss
Semaglutide NAION labelling reflects association, not proven causation
GLP-1 RAs and glaucoma/ocular hypertension: systematic review and meta-analysis
GLP-1 RA use associated with more severe acute pancreatitis (observational)

candidates.topic: How to use the tirzepatide pen: injection sites (abdomen, thigh, upper arm), rotating them, and a drop of blood or a red spot, per the Instructions for Use
candidates.angle: Device how-to, using the Instructions for Use only and no amounts. Make 'Is this normal?' pen Shorts (bleeding drop, bruise, pen dropped) that point to the Pen how-to. Pen is flagged at day 14 (123 impressions), so give it new Shorts to feed it rather than a new video. Zepbound vial vs pen only if the real IFU URL loads.
candidates.why_now: Device how-tos are a search format that beats channel norms by 10–195x in this niche. Pen Shorts are a proven winner (pen blood got 1,466 on TikTok). The Pen video needs internal traffic.

evidence.source: Zepbound prescribing information and Instructions for Use
evidence.signal: Injection sites and rotation (section 2.4)
Injection-site reactions 6–8% vs about 2% on placebo

candidates.topic: Stopping tirzepatide and keeping results: SURMOUNT-4 (+14.0% regain on placebo, still 9.9% below baseline), refreshed by a UK GP's weight-regain warning
candidates.angle: Feed the Stopping → Keeping Results series with Shorts on the felt moment: 'Stopped Mounjaro and hunger came back?' Give the fact in the same sentence and point to Stopping. Never give stopping or switching advice; suggest planning any change with your prescriber.
keywords: what happens when you stop zepbound
candidates.why_now: Wales Online ran a GP warning about regain (24 Nov). Stopping is our fastest-growing earner (818 min, 5.3% CTR).

evidence.signal: Wegovy and Mounjaro weight regain warning from a GP
Continued tirzepatide vs switching to placebo, weight maintenance

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide and muscle, bones and falls: ABC Australia's falls and fractures warning plus the T-REx trial (lifting weights, about 25% less lean-mass loss)
candidates.angle: A positive 'how to protect yourself' angle: 'Mounjaro and muscle: does lifting weights help?' Give the trial result first, then 2 practical steps (protein, strength training). This is the moment to retitle the Strength video. Never fear-monger about fractures.
candidates.why_now: ABC Australia (24 Nov) warned of falls and fractures in the weight-loss-drug boom, and Australian Foundayo pharmacy access adds AU audience interest. T-REx coverage continues, and Fi Europe flagged protein products aimed at GLP-1 users.

evidence.signal: Weight-loss drug boom could leave Australians facing falls and fractures

candidates.topic: Eating enough on tirzepatide: nutrients when appetite drops, with the new cohort study on nutritional-deficiency anemia (tirzepatide vs other GLP-1s)
candidates.angle: 'Mounjaro and always tired: are you eating enough?' Present the anemia study as observational (a link, not proof). Give practical, non-extreme protein and iron-rich food ideas, and suggest asking a clinician about blood tests. No restrictive-diet messaging.
candidates.why_now: The Diabetes Res Clin Pract cohort (17 Nov) is fresh. This topic has been in the radar 7 times. What to Eat is a top earner (1,251 min).

evidence.signal: Tirzepatide and nutritional-deficiency anemia vs GLP-1 RAs in type 2 diabetes (cohort)

candidates.topic: Semaglutide (Wegovy) in children aged 6–11: STEP Young randomized trial (NEJM 16 Nov; BMI −13.5% vs +2.7% on placebo at 68 weeks)
candidates.angle: For parents, a calm explainer of what the trial found, including the smaller effect at 104 weeks and NewsNation's 'kids grew less' point. Note it is not a US-approved use in this age group (verify approval status before scripting). It's outside our usual adult focus, so use it only as a Short or a chapter. No advocacy.
candidates.why_now: HCPLive (24 Nov), NewsNation 'kids grew less' (23 Nov) and Becker's all covered it. Parents' questions are surging.

evidence.signal: Wegovy leads to substantial BMI decrease in children aged 6–11
40% of children dropped below the obesity threshold

candidates.topic: GLP-1s and men's health: testosterone and sperm count improved after 24 weeks in men with a high BMI (new study, wide syndicated coverage)
candidates.angle: Benefits-beyond-weight angle for male viewers. Make clear the study was only in men with a high BMI and is early, and that weight loss itself is the likely driver. Never frame it as a fertility treatment or a TRT replacement. Check the primary paper and design before scripting.
candidates.why_now: ScienceAlert (24 Nov) plus Scripps syndication across dozens of local stations. Few creator videos so far.

evidence.signal: GLP-1s improved male testosterone levels and sperm count over 24 weeks

candidates.topic: Retatrutide and sleep apnea: TRIUMPH-1-OSA (NEJM; up to 60.6% fewer breathing events at 80 weeks)
candidates.angle: Only a 'what's coming' chapter inside a sleep apnea or pipeline video, alongside approved options. Retatrutide is unapproved: no 'What is retatrutide?' video, no Shorts, and say clearly that it's only available in trials. Online sellers are illegal (Hyderabad and Health Canada seizures).
candidates.why_now: Motley Fool and Yahoo's 'Forget Zepbound' piece, 2 Minute Medicine and the BHF explainer all appeared 24 Nov, but it's a pipeline drug and the gray-market risk is high.

evidence.signal: TRIUMPH-OSA: retatrutide reduces sleep apnea severity
